2,500+members training this year

Quiet floor. Heavy iron.

FORGE opened with 40 racks and a rule: no mirrors-and-music theatre. Just serious equipment, coaches who watch every set, and a room that keeps its volume down so you can keep your focus up.

Every member begins with a movement assessment and leaves each session with a plan for the next one. Over ten years that approach has built a community that trains together and holds each other to the work.

Meet the founder

Why members stay

The average FORGE member has trained with us for four years. Here is what keeps them.

  1. World-class equipment

    Calibrated plates, competition racks and sled lanes, serviced weekly.

  2. Certified trainers

    Every coach holds a recognised qualification and completes yearly education.

  3. Personalised plans

    Programs update after each block based on your logged results.

  4. Premium environment

    Private lockers, a recovery suite and a floor capped at a set capacity.

  5. Flexible plans

    Month to month, pause when you travel, upgrade whenever you want.

  6. Supportive community

    Training groups, member events and coaches who know your name.
